method: Exploratory shared-process filters differ and can alter JIT context. Close medians are not stable comparisons across filters. Final all-workload evidence in time-hillclimb-results.json; storage-layout ABBA in time-storage-experiments.json.

experiments.name: time-abi13-baseline

Initial native/calendar/timezone setup measured separately from hot loops; calendar setup includes registry validation. Hot operations exclude startup. timeParse/timeAdd read nanosecond; timeRoundFormat includes formatting. Gzip level9, esbuild es2022 minification. Separately compressed module sums and consumer bundles are alternative delivery modes.
